title: Build the next idea from the same model
before: The learner recognizes the system and its earlier behavior.
after: They can explain why the next topic follows from the previous one.
sequence: Introduce the smallest change that answers the current question.
Follow its consequences in the same story.
observation: The opening explicitly recalls transformations, determinants, linear systems, and change of basis.
interpretation: Treat prerequisites as reusable mental models; explicitly connect later difficulties to earlier changes.
example: Adding a worker leads to two follow-up questions: who still has socket access, and what remains after the worker exits?
avoid: An isolated demonstration for every concept.
Leaving the connection to previous parts until the final exercise.
check: Can the learner explain why this chapter comes next?

review.interpretation: user-approved design direction; application needs learner review
